title: Santorini Caldera Escape
summary: Cave suites, caldera sailing and sunsets from your own terrace.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Imerovigli
itinerary.text: Private transfer to a cave suite on the caldera rim. Welcome dinner of Santorinian fava and grilled octopus.

itinerary.title: The quiet villages
itinerary.text: Morning walk along the cliff path to Oia before the crowds, then Pyrgos and its Venetian lanes with a local historian.

itinerary.title: Catamaran day
itinerary.text: A private catamaran to the hot springs, Red Beach and a swim stop off Thirasia, lunch cooked on board.

itinerary.title: Volcanic wine
itinerary.text: Assyrtiko tasting at a family winery, then a long, unscheduled afternoon by the infinity pool.

itinerary.title: Akrotiri at opening
itinerary.text: The Bronze Age city with an archaeologist at opening hour, followed by a black-sand beach lunch in Perissa.

itinerary.title: Farewell
itinerary.text: Slow breakfast on the terrace and a private transfer for your onward flight.

included: 7 nights in a caldera cave suite

title: Kyoto in Slow Motion
summary: Ryokan nights, private temple gardens and kaiseki by lantern light.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kyoto
itinerary.text: Met at Kyoto Station and settled into a townhouse hotel in Higashiyama. Evening stroll through Gion.

itinerary.title: Gardens before the gates open
itinerary.text: A private early visit to a Zen garden, then Kiyomizu-dera and the lanes of Sannenzaka with a cultural guide.

itinerary.title: Tea ceremony
itinerary.text: A tea ceremony hosted by a twelfth-generation tea master, followed by a lesson in wagashi sweet-making.

itinerary.title: Ryokan in the hills
itinerary.text: Two nights in a family-run ryokan with a private onsen and multi-course kaiseki dinners.

itinerary.title: Arashiyama by bicycle
itinerary.text: Ride through the bamboo grove at dawn and along the Katsura river to a riverside tofu lunch.

itinerary.title: Nara and farewell
itinerary.text: A day trip to Nara's temples, then a final kaiseki dinner and a private transfer to Kansai Airport.

included: 9 nights in a townhouse hotel and ryokan

title: Kyoto & the Kumano Kodo
summary: Kyoto's temples, then four days on Japan's ancient pilgrimage trail.

itinerary.title: Kyoto essentials
itinerary.text: Fushimi Inari at sunrise, Kinkaku-ji and a private Gion evening with a maiko performance.

itinerary.title: Into the Kii mountains
itinerary.text: Rail and private car to Takijiri, the traditional start of the Nakahechi route.

itinerary.title: Walking the Kumano Kodo
itinerary.text: Guided forest walks of 10–15 km a day, with luggage sent ahead to minshuku guesthouses each night.

itinerary.title: Hongu Taisha
itinerary.text: Arrive at the grand shrine, then soak in the river-fed hot spring at Kawayu.

itinerary.title: Koyasan temple stay
itinerary.text: A night in a Buddhist temple lodging on Mount Koya, then back to Kyoto for your flight.

included: 12 nights in hotels, guesthouses and a temple lodging
Breakfasts and dinners on the trail

title: Marrakech & the Agafay Desert
summary: A riad in the medina, the souks with a master guide, and a night under desert stars.

itinerary.title: Into the medina
itinerary.text: Met at the airport and walked into a restored riad. Mint tea on the roof as the call to prayer begins.

itinerary.title: Souks and palaces
itinerary.text: The souks with a guide who has walked them for thirty years, Bahia Palace, and a hammam ritual.

itinerary.title: Atlas foothills
itinerary.text: Drive into the Ourika valley for a Berber family lunch and a walk to the waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Agafay desert camp
itinerary.text: Camel ride at sunset, dinner by firelight and a canvas suite under the stars.

itinerary.title: Gardens and farewell
itinerary.text: Jardin Majorelle at opening, a cooking class, and a private transfer to the airport.

included: 6 nights in a medina riad, 1 night in a desert camp

title: Bali: Jungle to Reef
summary: Ubud's rice terraces and temples, then cliff-top days on the Bukit coast.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Ubud
itinerary.text: Private transfer to a pool villa above the Ayung river valley.

itinerary.title: Rice terraces and temples
itinerary.text: Sunrise at Tegallalang, a water-temple blessing at Tirta Empul, and a visit to a woodcarving village.

itinerary.title: Ubud slow days
itinerary.text: Yoga at dawn, a Balinese cooking class with market visit, and a traditional massage.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu cliffs
itinerary.text: Move south to a cliff-top retreat. Snorkelling trip to Nusa Penida and a Kecak fire dance at sunset.

itinerary.title: Farewell
itinerary.text: A late check-out and private transfer to Denpasar.

title: Bali Retreat & Reset
summary: Two weeks of yoga, spa rituals and plant-based cooking in the hills of Ubud.

itinerary.title: Arrive at the retreat
itinerary.text: Private transfer to a wellness resort in the hills north of Ubud, then a consultation with your wellness guide.

itinerary.title: Settle into the rhythm
itinerary.text: Daily yoga and meditation, a personalised spa programme and plant-based meals from the resort garden.

itinerary.title: Mountain sunrise
itinerary.text: An optional pre-dawn hike up Mount Batur for sunrise over the caldera lake.

itinerary.title: Deepen the practice
itinerary.text: Breathwork, sound healing and a Balinese healer visit, with afternoons kept free.

itinerary.title: Farewell
itinerary.text: A closing ceremony and a private transfer to Denpasar.

title: Torres del Paine Expedition
summary: An all-inclusive lodge inside the park, guided hikes and Grey Glacier by boat.

itinerary.title: Santiago to Puerto Natales
itinerary.text: A night in Santiago, then a flight south and a private drive into Torres del Paine.

itinerary.title: Base of the Towers
itinerary.text: The park's classic hike to the granite towers, graded to your pace with an expert guide.

itinerary.title: Lakes and waterfalls
itinerary.text: Salto Grande, the Lago Pehoé lookout, and a gentler day riding with gauchos.

itinerary.title: Grey Glacier
itinerary.text: A boat across Grey Lake to the face of the glacier, with whisky on glacial ice.

itinerary.title: Your choice of trails
itinerary.text: French Valley, kayaking on the Serrano river, or a puma-tracking day with a wildlife guide.

itinerary.title: Farewell
itinerary.text: A lamb asado at a working estancia before your flight north.

included: 10 nights incl. an all-inclusive park lodge
Meals and drinks at the lodge

title: Patagonia End to End
summary: Fitz Roy, Perito Moreno and Torres del Paine across both sides of the border.

itinerary.title: Buenos Aires
itinerary.text: Tango, parrilla and the Recoleta quarter before flying south to El Calafate.

itinerary.title: El Chaltén and Fitz Roy
itinerary.text: Guided hikes to Laguna de los Tres and Laguna Torre from a mountain lodge.

itinerary.title: Perito Moreno
itinerary.text: Walk on the glacier with crampons, then watch it calve from the boardwalks.

itinerary.title: Torres del Paine
itinerary.text: Cross into Chile for five nights at an all-inclusive lodge inside the park.

itinerary.title: Punta Arenas
itinerary.text: A final day on the Strait of Magellan and a flight home via Santiago.

included: 14 nights in lodges and boutique hotels
Glacier walk and all guided hikes

title: Iceland under the Aurora
summary: Reykjavík design hotels, a glass-roofed lodge and ice caves with a glaciologist.

itinerary.title: Reykjavík
itinerary.text: Check in to a design hotel in the old harbour and dine on New Nordic cooking.

itinerary.title: Golden Circle
itinerary.text: Þingvellir, Geysir and Gullfoss with a private guide, then a soak in a quiet geothermal lagoon.

itinerary.title: South coast
itinerary.text: By super-jeep to Seljalandsfoss, the black sands of Vík, and a glass-roofed lodge for aurora watching.

itinerary.title: Ice cave
itinerary.text: Into a blue-ice cave in Vatnajökull with a glaciologist, then the icebergs of Jökulsárlón.

itinerary.title: Return to Reykjavík
itinerary.text: Drive back along the coast, with a final night of seafood in the capital.

included: 6 nights in a design hotel and aurora lodge

title: Ring Road by Super-Jeep
summary: The whole island, fjords to glaciers, with a private driver-guide.

itinerary.title: Reykjavík and Snæfellsnes
itinerary.text: The capital, then the peninsula of Kirkjufell, lava caves and fishing villages.

itinerary.title: The north
itinerary.text: Akureyri, whale watching from Húsavík and the Mývatn nature baths.

itinerary.title: East fjords
itinerary.text: Dettifoss, the quiet fjord towns and reindeer country.

itinerary.title: Glaciers
itinerary.text: Jökulsárlón, Diamond Beach, a glacier hike and an ice cave with a glaciologist.

itinerary.title: South coast
itinerary.text: Vík, Skógafoss and a last night by the sea before the airport.

included: 11 nights in boutique hotels and farm stays

title: Amalfi Coast, Long Lunches
summary: A terrace above Positano, a wooden gozzo to hidden coves, and Ravello's gardens.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Positano
itinerary.text: Private driver from Naples to a terrace room above the beach. Aperitivo at sunset.

itinerary.title: By boat to Capri
itinerary.text: A wooden gozzo to Capri's grottoes and coves, lunch at a beach club only reachable by sea.

itinerary.title: Path of the Gods
itinerary.text: A guided walk high above the coast from Bomerano to Nocelle, then down to Positano.

itinerary.title: Ravello
itinerary.text: Villa Cimbrone's gardens, a cooking class in a lemon grove, and a concert evening.

itinerary.title: Pompeii and farewell
itinerary.text: Pompeii with an archaeologist on the way back to Naples for your flight.

included: Cooking class in a lemon grove

title: Cappadocia & Istanbul
summary: Sunrise balloons, cave suites and two days in Istanbul's old city.

itinerary.title: Istanbul
itinerary.text: Sultanahmet's mosques and the Grand Bazaar with a historian guide.

itinerary.title: The Bosphorus
itinerary.text: A private boat between two continents and dinner in Karaköy.

itinerary.title: Fly to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: A short flight to a cave suite in Uçhisar with views across the valleys.

itinerary.title: Sunrise balloon
itinerary.text: A dawn balloon flight over the fairy chimneys, then the Göreme open-air museum.

itinerary.title: Underground cities
itinerary.text: Derinkuyu with an archaeologist and a vineyard dinner with Anatolian wines.

itinerary.title: Farewell
itinerary.text: A valley walk at first light and a transfer to Kayseri for your flight.

included: 6 nights in Istanbul and a Cappadocia cave hotel
